tech-doc.name: Technical Documentation Checklist
tech-doc.section-1.name: General Product Description
tech-doc.section-2.name: Design and Development Information
tech-doc.section-3.name: Conformity Assessment and Testing
tech-doc.section-4.name: Information and Instructions to the User (Annex II)
tech-doc.TD-1.requirement: A general description of the product with digital elements, including its intended purpose and versions of software affecting compliance with the CRA
tech-doc.TD-2.requirement: Photographs or illustrations of external features, marking and internal layout of the product
tech-doc.TD-3.requirement: Information on the design, development and production of the product and vulnerability handling processes
tech-doc.TD-4.requirement: The essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I that are applicable to the product, and the explanation of how they are met
tech-doc.TD-5.requirement: A description of the assessment of cybersecurity risks against which the product is designed, developed, produced and intended to be used
tech-doc.TD-6.requirement: Information on the hardware, software and firmware components of the product and their dependencies, including a software bill of materials (SBOM)
tech-doc.TD-7.requirement: A copy of the EU declaration of conformity or a reference to its internet address
tech-doc.TD-8.requirement: A description of the conformity assessment procedure applied, and where the procedure under Article 32(3) was applied, a reference to the EU-type examination certificate
tech-doc.TD-9.requirement: The results of conformity assessment tests performed by the manufacturer or on behalf of the manufacturer
tech-doc.TD-10.requirement: A list of fully or partly applied harmonised standards or common specifications, and where those harmonised standards or common specifications have not been applied, descriptions of the solutions adopted to meet the essential requirements
tech-doc.TD-11.requirement: Reports from tests carried out by the manufacturer or on behalf of the manufacturer during the internal production control (Module A)
tech-doc.TD-12.requirement: Name, registered trade name or registered trade mark and contact address of the manufacturer
tech-doc.TD-13.requirement: Instructions for installation, operation and use of the product with digital elements in an easily understandable way
tech-doc.TD-14.requirement: The point of contact where the manufacturer can be reached, including an internet address
tech-doc.TD-15.requirement: Information on the support period of the product, including at least the end date
